title: Polio, instruments in the house, first drums at school
summary: Braced from polio, he was given instruments at home; drums came first, taught by Sister Cyril, and he played in the school band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Yeah, over the thirties, yeah. But matter of fact, I had just started playing trombone professionally then. Yeah. Because see, I've been learning music ever since I was, well I say born, you see. Yeah. Because I had polio, and I was full of braces, so he bought all the instruments and put it at the house. So my first instrument was drum. I was studying drum music from Sister Cyril at Copper Crystal School. And, but he always wanted me to learn trombone. Well I did, in the meantime I would learn the trombone, drum and...
What did you, what was your very first instrument then?
Yeah, very first. And that was, you played that in the school band at Marcus Christie? Yeah, yeah.
I've heard about it, a few people have told us about that band. Was it just the regular during school hours or something extra outside?

Just school hours and then they used to have little concerts we used to play. Mm-hm. But I was playing drums in there. Yeah. I forget that. It wasn't no marching band, it was because we had violins and things like that. Yeah.
